paper.title: GASP: Guided Asymmetric Self-Play For Coding LLMs
paper.central_claim: 困难真实题引导的lemma–lift自博弈课程优于无引导AZR，提升代码模型pass@k并解出原本不可解goalposts。

evidence.quote: and differ only by role prompting; all updates are applied to the same weights.
evidence.support_explanation: 明示共享权重更新，非留存harness编辑。

evidence.quote: For each seed of our RL runs, we perform single-checkpoint model selection by choosing the checkpoint that maximizes pass@20 on the LCB
evidence.support_explanation: 报告评测集参与checkpoint选择，不能称独立测试。

evidence.quote: solves 11 unique goalpost questions out of 146 (6/3/3 per seed, union of 11 across three seeds)
evidence.support_explanation: 困难集结果是跨seed与checkpoint联合发现，不是稳定能力。

evidence.quote: Each iteration is more costly than without rejection sampling, as the teacher must generate multiple proposals until a sufficiently novel one is accepted.
Finally, our framework uses a fixed set of goalposts.
evidence.support_explanation: goalpost及课程机制固定，不自我修改成持久harness。

evidence.quote: This diversity filter prevents mode collapse and encourages the teacher to generate a broad set of distinct lemma/lift questions.
evidence.support_explanation: 过滤生成训练实例，符合C08。

evidence.quote: does not reward the teacher directly for improving on goalpost questions; solving goalposts is instead a byproduct of learning from lemma–lift stepping stones.
evidence.support_explanation: 区分SOAR式下游gain reward与本文课程reward。

evidence.quote: differ only by role prompting; all updates are applied to the same weights.
evidence.support_explanation: Teacher and student are the same weights; every update is a weight update.

evidence.quote: For RL updates, we use Task-Relative REINFORCE++ as proposed in Absolute Zero
evidence.support_explanation: Training is RL on weights; lemma/lift questions are RL training data.

evidence.quote: questions should be challenging yet solvable for the student.
evidence.support_explanation: Teacher reward is learnability of generated questions; the retained product is the trained model.

evidence.quote: our framework uses a fixed set of goalposts.
evidence.support_explanation: The goalpost set is a fixed evaluation-derived training subset, not a retained, edited harness artifact.

evidence.quote: and differ only by role prompting; all updates are applied to the same weights.
evidence.support_explanation: Teacher and student are one policy whose improvement is a weight update.

evidence.quote: The teacher is rewarded based on the student’s performance on its proposals
evidence.support_explanation: Difficulty-steered proposer reward, the H22 / C08 signal.

signatures.information: 训练分割601题中经RL/AZR筛出的146 hard goalposts；teacher生成代码、I/O及任务；solver N=10成功率

signatures.conditions: 可执行确定性代码；2 public+3 private generated I/O tests
signatures.feedback: 生成代码执行正确性与learnability reward
signatures.selection_rule: pass-rate bands+validity+novelty决定训练样本；LCB eval pass@20选择checkpoint
signatures.selection_data: LCB pre-2024.08训练、2024.10–2025.02 eval用于选择
signatures.persistence: LoRA/模型参数（论文称更新weights）；global buffers用于novelty检查，不作为任务推理记忆被评测

rs_pattern.reason: Informational (out_of_scope). Opus confirms sol: the generator proposes verifiable tasks, the solver's pass rate steers the generator, a filter (critic score / validity checks) admits tasks, and the shared policy is retrained. This is C08's generate → steer → filter → retrain loop, the run convention for proposer–solver co-training (r05b R-Zero, r07b Search Self-play/SPICE, r09b GenEnv, r11a Dr. Zero). son55 skipped identification. The run records identification for excluded rows, so the empty pattern is replaced. No score effect.
